Read a SAS XPORT (.xpt) file

Source: R/xpt_rw.r
ks_read_xpt.Rd

Reads a SAS XPORT v5 or v8/v9 file using a built-in C++ parser. Variable labels, formats, and informats are preserved as column attributes (`"label"`, `"format.sas"`, `"sas.informat"`). Multi-member files are returned as a named list of tibbles, one per dataset.

Usage

ks_read_xpt(file, convert_dates = TRUE, warn = TRUE, n_threads = NULL)

Arguments

file

Path to a SAS XPORT file.

convert_dates

Logical. If `TRUE` (default), columns formatted as SAS dates or datetimes are converted to R `Date` / `POSIXct`. If `FALSE`, such columns are returned as numeric SAS day / second values.

warn

Logical. If `TRUE` (default), parser warnings are emitted via [cli::cli_warn].

n_threads

Integer or `NULL`. Number of decoder threads to use. `NULL` (default) selects `max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)`. Set to `1L` for fully deterministic single-threaded decoding.

Value

A tibble for a single-member file, or a named list of tibbles for a multi-member file.

Details

Date and datetime conversion, when enabled, applies the SAS-to-R epoch shift of 3653 days (315,619,200 seconds) and assigns the appropriate `Date` / `POSIXct` class to columns whose SAS format is recognised as a date or datetime format.

See also

[ks_write_xpt()], [ks_xpt_labels()], [ks_xpt_formats()], [ks_set_labels()], [ks_set_formats()]
